A few good questions

Before you
bring your data.

Where does my spreadsheet go?

Your file is processed in your browser. TidySheet has no file upload endpoint, analytics, or cloud data storage. Closing or refreshing the page clears the workspace. Read the privacy and data notes.

Is it really free?

Yes. This version is free, with no account or payment required. Each file can be up to 20 MB, with a maximum of 100,000 data rows, 100 columns, and 1,000,000 cells per sheet.

What happens to my formulas and formatting?

TidySheet cleans tabular values from one selected sheet. It creates a new file and does not preserve workbook formatting, macros, or formulas. Formula cells use the values saved by your spreadsheet app; recalculate and save your workbook before importing.

Can it fix every mistake automatically?

It standardizes supported formats and flags values it cannot validate. It cannot confirm whether a phone is active, an email is deliverable, or a record is factually correct. Invalid source values are preserved for your review.

Will it merge records for me?

No. When you enable duplicate removal, the first matching row is kept and later matches are removed. Choose key columns carefully: different transactions may share the same customer. Blank or invalid selected keys are never used to remove a row.
